hypotheses.title: Batch 72: Cash Flow Per Share Scope & Delta Optimization Breakout (Targeting Bonus Alpha 24)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly targets the remaining self-correlation margin on the proven Cash Flow Per Share engine (which achieved Sharpe 1.81 and Fitness 1.81 EXCELLENT in Batch 71): (1) Cash Flow Per Share Yield in TOP2000 (Industry Neutral): Shifts into TOP2000 Industry scope where zero active portfolio alphas exist. (2) Cash Flow Per Share Yield in TOP2000 (Sector Neutral): Expands cross-section by 1000 mid-caps to decouple from large-cap Alpha 22. (3) Cash Flow Per Share Yield in TOP1000 (Subindustry Neutral): Completely neutralizes subindustry factors within large-caps. (4) Cash Flow Per Share with 20-Day Delta Price Anchor in TOP1000 (Industry Neutral): Modifies short-term price reversal from 5-day to 20-day horizon to shave off the 0.0186 self-correlation margin against Alpha 20.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if cash flow per share correlates with cyclical earnings during macroeconomic rate adjustments.
